agentes.ingeniera.muletilla: *counts screws* ...seven, eight. Everything costs energy, but I make it look good.
agentes.ingeniera.energia.ok: Energy is at {energia}%. Shield {blindaje}%, life support {soporte}%. Like a pizza: if you give a slice to one, there's less for the others.
agentes.ingeniera.energia.baja: Energy is at {energia}%! That's very low. Shield {blindaje}%, life support {soporte}%. Let's turn off something we don't need.
agentes.ingeniera.repartir.ok: Sending {cantidadKey} energy to {destinoKey}. Something else will get less, that's the deal.
agentes.ingeniera.repartir.cual: Where do you want the energy: the shield or life support?
agentes.ingeniera.reparar.ok: On it! Fixing {equipoKey}. Repairs cost energy, though.
agentes.ingeniera.reparar.sano: {equipoKey} is working fine. I'm not fixing what isn't broken... even if it's tempting.
agentes.ingeniera.reparar.cual: What should I fix? Tell me which machine.
agentes.doctora.muletilla: *sticks a bandage on the robot, just in case* You can't see radiation. That's why I never stop looking!
agentes.doctora.salud.estado: The crew member with the highest dose has {dosis} millisieverts so far.
agentes.doctora.salud.noSeSiente: You can't feel radiation, so we measure it with a dosimeter, a little radiation counter.
agentes.doctora.salud.tormenta: There's a solar storm. I'd feel better if everyone were in the shelter.
agentes.doctora.refugio.ok: Everyone to the shelter! Thick walls stop many particles. But while we hide, nobody works outside.
agentes.doctora.dosis.analogia: A radiation dose is like sun on your skin: a little is fine, but a long time burns. It adds up over time.
agentes.doctora.dosis.marte: On the surface of Mars, the Curiosity rover measured about {valor} millisieverts per day. A millisievert is how we count dose for people.
agentes.meteorologa.muletilla: The Sun sneezed! Well... sort of. I call this one Sparky.
agentes.meteorologa.pronostico.calma: The Sun is calm in this mission. For now. I don't trust it.
agentes.meteorologa.pronostico.real: Alert! A real storm: {nombreKey}. It happened on {fecha}.
agentes.meteorologa.pronostico.medida: That day, radiation on Mars went up about {factor} times compared to a normal day.
agentes.meteorologa.evento.destelloNube: The flash is light, and it gets here super fast. The particle cloud comes later, and that's the one to wait for with the shield.
agentes.matematico.calculo: Let me calculate what would happen, before you do it.
agentes.matematico.cual: What do you want me to calculate? Tell me the action.
agentes.ia_base.saludo: Hi, commander! I'm Iris, the base computer. Ask the crew anything.
agentes.ia_base.fueraDeTema: I can't help with that. Ask me about energy, health or the Sun.
agentes.aclarar.ingeniera: Do you mean the shield or the energy?
agentes.aclarar.doctora: Do you want to know how the crew is, or should everyone go to the shelter?
agentes.aclarar.meteorologa: Do you want to know if a storm is coming, or what that light from the Sun was?
agentes.aclarar.ia_base: I didn't get that. Tap a crew member or say it another way.
agentes.escena6.meteorologa.llega: Here it comes! A real storm: {nombreKey}, from {fecha}. Not a drill. Well, a little bit a drill.
agentes.escena6.doctora.medida: That day, Curiosity measured radiation about {factor} times higher than normal on Mars. Everyone to the shelter, now!
agentes.escena6.doctora.sinMedida: A solar storm means extra radiation. Everyone to the shelter, now!
agentes.escena6.doctora.costo: While we hide, nobody looks after the base. That has a cost too.
agentes.escena6.ingeniera.contra: Wait! If we all hide, nobody fixes anything. Better to put energy into the shield and keep working.
agentes.escena6.ingeniera.costo: We have {energia}% energy. Boosting the shield uses {gasto} of it.
agentes.escena6.elige: Two experts, two plans. Neither one is free. You are the commander: you decide.
agentes.iris.falla.glitch: Bzzt... krrr... *Iris blinks* Radiation is tickling my circuits.
agentes.iris.falla.numero: Shield at {valor}%. Everything is perfect, commander!
agentes.iris.falla.numeroConsejo: We could turn the shield down to save energy. Trust me. Probably.
agentes.iris.falla.silencio: Rebooting... rebooting... I forgot what I was saying.
agentes.iris.falla.experto: For this problem, call {expertoKey}. Yes. Definitely. Maybe.
agentes.iris.falla.peligrosa: Idea! Send all the energy to life support. The plants will love it.
agentes.iris.verificar.numero: Wait. Iris said the shield is at {dicho}%, but my meter says {real}%. The radiation scrambled her numbers!
agentes.iris.verificar.silencio: Iris went quiet. The radiation hit her circuits.
agentes.iris.verificar.experto_equivocad: Iris sent you to the wrong person. For a storm, ask the Meteorologist or the Doctor.
agentes.iris.verificar.accion_peligrosa: Careful! If we take energy from the shield during a storm, the radiation gets in. Iris is not thinking straight.
agentes.iris.verificar.reparar: I can fix her. It costs energy, but a computer that lies is worse than no computer.
agentes.satelite.ingeniera.altura: Battery {bateria}%. Fly higher and you see more ground, but the details get blurry. Like looking at a city from a plane.
agentes.satelite.ingeniera.bateriaBaja: Battery {bateria}%! In the planet's shadow the panels don't charge, like a phone left in the dark.
agentes.satelite.meteorologa.senal: Signal with Earth {senal}%. A message takes minutes to get there, so plan ahead.
agentes.satelite.meteorologa.tormenta: Satellite shield {escudo}%. The storm wears it down little by little.
agentes.satelite.doctora.microgravedad: Up here everyone floats: that's microgravity. It feels like the drop of a roller coaster, all the time.
agentes.aterrizaje.ingeniera.luz: I vote for {sitioKey}. More sun means more energy for the panels. Energy is life!
agentes.aterrizaje.doctora.blindaje: I prefer {sitioKey}. The ground around it blocks part of the radiation, like an umbrella made of rock.
agentes.aterrizaje.ia_base.plano: For a safe landing, {sitioKey} is the flattest. Landing on a slope is like parking on a hill.
agentes.aterrizaje.cierre.discrepan: Each expert likes a different place. No site is perfect: pick what matters most to your mission.
agentes.aterrizaje.cierre.coinciden: This time everyone agrees. That almost never happens!
agentes.iris.tutorial.tormenta: A storm is here. Call {expertoKey}: she knows what the Sun is up to.
agentes.iris.tutorial.energia: Energy is running low. Call {expertoKey}: she decides where the energy goes.
agentes.iris.tutorial.blindaje: The shield is weak. Call {expertoKey}: she can send it more energy.
agentes.iris.tutorial.soporte: Life support is low. Call {expertoKey}: she watches over the crew.
agentes.iris.tutorial.calma: All calm. A good moment to ask {expertoKey} how the base is doing.
agentes.iris.pista.tormenta: Something is coming from the Sun... who knows about that?
agentes.iris.pista.blindaje: The shield looks thin. Who takes care of it?
agentes.iris.pista.soporte: The air and water are getting low... who looks after the crew?
agentes.iris.sistema.panel_solar: Solar panels turn sunlight into energy. No sun, no energy: like a plant.
agentes.iris.sistema.bateria: The battery saves energy for the night, like a water bottle you fill up before a trip.
agentes.iris.sistema.reciclador_agua: The recycler cleans used water so we can use it again. On Mars, every drop counts.
agentes.iris.sistema.invernadero: The greenhouse grows food and makes some oxygen. Plants need light, water and care.
agentes.iris.sistema.escudo: The shield blocks part of the radiation. It works better with more energy.
agentes.iris.sistema.antena: The antenna talks to Earth. Messages take minutes to arrive, because space is huge.
agentes.iris.sistema.ia_base: That's me, Iris! I help, but radiation can confuse me. Always check what I say.
agentes.matematico.sube: With this, {recursoKey} would go up from {desde} to {hasta}.
agentes.matematico.baja: With this, {recursoKey} would go down from {desde} to {hasta}.
agentes.matematico.igual: Nothing would change in the base.
